newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU will have problems with Anglo stake in Lonrho.
newsitem.headline: EU will have problems with Anglo stake in Lonrho.

text.p: Anglo-American Corp of South Africa's controlling stake in Lonrho will have problems getting clearance under European Union competition rules, Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Tuesday, but he hoped the companies would provide a solution.
"They know the problem, they are willing to discuss it," Van Miert told Reuters after speaking on competition issues at a lunch organised by the American Chamber of Commerce.
He declined to comment on what sort of changes the companies would have to come up with to get EU approval for Anglo's stake in Lonrho.

"I know they are seriously thinking about it but I cannot be more precise at this stage of the proceedings," Van Miert said, stressing that it was for the companies to suggest a remedy to avoid compeition in the EU being harmed.
Earlier this year the Commission blocked the merger of the platinum interests of Britain's Lonrho and South African mining group Gencor, warning Anglo at the time about taking control of Lonrho.
